summary: Tested the comparison between the CV skill map and a job's skill map (SkillCompare / JobMap / skill_match). Backend: 11 of 11 pytest checks pass (sources, source with 404 and 422, history save/list/get, validation of source_kind and score, per-member isolation). Frontend: everything works end to end. The existing SkillMap still works (bubbles, skill-map-detail). The skill-compare-open card sits just below it. The dialog has 4 tabs. Pasted text with a logistics supervisor offer gives a score of 19 %, the counts, 8 gaps sorted by importance, 6 recommendations, the verdict, the common domains, a job map with 10 bubbles and a detail panel with Couverte/Partielle/Manquante and Requise/Souhaitée (Lean 'un atout' → Souhaitée). A Radar offer gives 82 % with a link to the 'tools' lever. A pack gives 28 %. History lists each comparison and reopens it without saving it again. At 390px the columns stack with no horizontal overflow. Main problem: in the light theme (the default seen) the dialog is almost unreadable.

minor.issue: No size limit on 'result' and 'texts' (any dict is accepted). There is no DELETE endpoint for history and no cap on stored documents (the list shows only the last 100).

ui_bugs.issue: DialogContent hardcodes bg-[#0d1018] (dark), but theme-light.css remaps .text-white/.text-slate-100 to #0f172a and slate-200/300/400 to darker tones. Result: dark text on a near-black background. The score '19 %', the gap labels, the recommendation titles, compare-job-title, the job-map-detail labels and the dialog title are all almost invisible. Confirmed with a screenshot at 1920 and at 390.

issues: Lever links are too narrow. skill→'kpi', cert→'cert_lean' (for every certificate, so 'Chariot élévateur' would be linked to the Lean Six Sigma lever), tool→'tools'. This member's levers are lead, cert_pm and tools, so a 'Supervision d'équipe' gap is never linked to 'lead' and PMP is never linked to 'cert_pm'. With the logistics offer, 0 of 6 recommendations had a lever.
The 6 recommendations for the logistics offer were all the same generic 'Mettre en évidence « X » dans le CV maître' text with an identical 'why' line, so they read as repetitive.

action_items: HIGH: make the SkillCompare dialog theme-aware. Use a background class that theme-light remaps (or add an html.light override for the dialog), or scope dark text colours to the dialog, so text is readable in the light theme.
Map recommendations to the matching levers: Leadership/supervision gaps → 'lead', PMP/CAPM → 'cert_pm', Lean → 'cert_lean' only. Do not link every cert to cert_lean.

Optional: refine the LEX aliases to avoid false positives. 'union' matches 'credit union' (Desjardins) → 'Relations de travail'. 'normes'/'qualite'/'incident'/'diplome'/'operations' are very broad. ' sap' matches any word starting with 'sap'.
Optional: cap the size of history result/texts and add a DELETE endpoint for history.
critical_code_review_comments: SkillCompare.jsx: bg-[#0d1018] is hardcoded, so the light theme breaks contrast (see ui_bugs).
skillMatch.js RECO: the cert→'cert_lean' mapping is semantically wrong for non-Lean certs, and the leadership domain is not linked to the 'lead' lever.
skillMatch.js: sentences are split on '-' and '–', which breaks hyphenated phrases and can cut a sentence before its 'atout' qualifier.
skill_match.py: HistoryIn.result/texts are unbounded dicts. Consider limits.
seed_data_creation: Comparisons were saved in history for membre.test (logistics pasted text, Desjardins radar, Ville de Montréal pack, plus mobile runs). The TEST_ entry was deleted from Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login at /careeros/login, page /careeros/memoire. Skill bubbles float (animation), so click them with force=True. The PrivacyBanner sits at the bottom. membre.test has 15 radar A/B offers and 13 packs. Strength levers for membre.test: lead, cert_pm, tools. Rerun tests/test_skill_match.py for regression.
